declared_at: 2026-10-30, before any model of this experiment was fitted; the earlier pipeline-check run (5 splits, GB only) and the separate reviewer run in 2026-10-30_fixed_stride_hust are known and are not used to choose anything below except as a reason to expect a modest effect
agreed_by_user: 2026-10-30: compute budget up to ~3 CPU hours, thresholds below, independent re-implementation (the reviewer's script is not imported)
hypothesis: A remaining-life estimator that combines charge-curve indicators with a capacity-trend Gaussian process, plus a completeness gate, beats the strongest capacity-only baseline on cells it has never seen, and its intervals reach nominal coverage.
data: HUST 77 LFP/graphite cells (CC BY 4.0, archive SHA256 pinned in hust.py), fixed physical stride 5, 8-point windows ending before the 90% SOH event, caches cells-fixed-stride5.json and indicators-fixed-stride5.json
target: cycles from the last window point to the 90% SOH event; censored cells have no windows and are excluded (counted in the report)
units: the cell is the independent unit; windows inside a cell are correlated

locked_confirmation_group.selection: permutation of cell ids with numpy default_rng(999), first 15; never used for baseline choice, tuning or threshold choice; evaluated once, after the development run
locked_confirmation_group.training_for_it: 42 development cells for training, 10 validation, 10 calibration, drawn with default_rng(777)

development_pool.splits: 10 grouped permutations, seeds 201-210; each: test 12, calibration 10, validation 10, train 30
development_pool.note: each cell lands in the test group in roughly 2 of 10 splits; per-cell results are averaged over its appearances before any interval is computed

models.linear_window: straight line through the 8 capacity points, extrapolated to 90%
models.ridge: ridge regression on the 8 capacity values
models.gpr_capacity: Gaussian process, RBF+White on standardized capacity, 800 training windows sampled with a fixed seed
models.gru_capacity: one-layer GRU, hidden 32, 40 epochs max, early stop on validation cells, capacity sequence only
models.gb_indicators: HistGradientBoosting on capacity + 4 charge-curve indicators (rise time, dQ/dV peak voltage, height, width)
models.ensemble_gated: ensemble when every indicator of the window is present, otherwise gpr_capacity only (completeness gate)

baseline_choice: pool member with the lowest mean macro-MAE on the validation cells over the 10 development splits; chosen before test errors are read

primary_comparisons.correction: two comparisons, so a Bonferroni 97.5% interval is used for the decision; the 95% interval is also printed

interval_variants: indicator-scaled (relative radius divided by mean indicator completeness)
interval_target: 90% nominal, calibration cells weighted equally per cell

scores: ensemble size (short predicted life accepted first)
kNN distance to training windows (applicability control)
abstention.risk: primary: macro-MAE of accepted windows; secondary: relative error with floor 50
abstention.compared_at: equal accepted share inside each split

quality_scenario: 30% of test windows get all indicator channels set to missing; compare gb_indicators ungated, ensemble ungated, ensemble_gated

go_no_go.note: Practical-significance values were agreed with the user on 2026-10-30; they are not tuned to results.
go_no_go.G1_significance: lower bound of the Bonferroni 97.5% paired cell-bootstrap interval of (baseline MAE - method MAE) > 0 on the development pool AND on the locked confirmation group
go_no_go.G2_practical: point estimate of the relative gain (baseline - method) / baseline >= 10% on both
go_no_go.G3_coverage: mean per-cell coverage of the chosen interval variant >= 0.85 on both
go_no_go.G4_abstention: claimed only if risk at 60% accepted <= 0.9 x risk at 100% accepted AND better than the 'ensemble size' ranking and better than random, with the bootstrap interval of the difference to the 'ensemble size' ranking excluding 0
go_no_go.G5_quality: ensemble_gated beats ungated on the missing-indicator scenario with a paired interval excluding 0, else the gate is not claimed
go_no_go.declaration: method is declared 'better' only if G1 and G2 hold on both groups; anything else is reported as 'no demonstrated gain'. A result of 'no gain' is an accepted outcome.

protocol_holdout: HUST discharge/charge protocol groups are only used if the cell-to-protocol mapping is confirmed from the dataset description or the source paper; otherwise reported as not verified
limits: Retrospective laboratory check on one dataset and one chemistry; windows are correlated; the cell split is the only independence unit; not field validation; no second dataset with charge curves is available locally.
